title: AI Agent 整理任务：从任务洪水到执行闭环
production_boundary: 五个镜头的严格配对首帧、尾帧、状态匹配 Prompt 和新首尾帧视频均已完成；五条外部视频模型结果已通过首尾抽帧核验，并由本地 FFmpeg 统一为 6 秒后接入。镜头 04 的既有 MP4 继续保留为历史单图实验，不计入新配对合同。

final_video.audio: MiniMax Chinese (Mandarin)_Gentleman / calm / speed 0.98 / AAC mono 48kHz

shots.title: 任务洪水
shots.narration: 任务真正让人忙乱，不是因为多，而是散落在消息、文档和脑子里。
shots.start_state: 同一人物与蓝色时间锚点固定；画面只有右上方一张空白任务卡，没有红色路径。
shots.end_state: 同一人物保持原位；七张空白任务卡环绕人物，红色混乱路径完整出现。
shots.image_prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: vertical 9:16 completed keyframe for shot 01 of a five-shot image-to-video sequence
Input images: Image 1 is a style and character reference only, not an edit target; generate a new composition while matching its Q-version Chinese creator, green outfit, black hair bun, crayon paper texture, line quality, and palette
Primary request: visualize “task overload begins as scattered work arrives from everywhere”
Scene/backdrop: solid warm-white #F8F6EF sketchbook paper with subtle natural grain
Subject: the same restrained Q-version Chinese creator stands in the lower center looking concerned but not panicked; six to eight completely blank paper task cards surround her in a loose storm; two tomato-red tangled arrows cross behind the cards; one simple blank clock icon without hands or digits tilts slightly at upper left; no AI machine yet
Style/medium: modern hand-drawn wax-crayon editorial illustration, rigid flat paper cutouts, thick imperfect black outlines, tactile handmade edges
Composition/framing: 3–4 large readable groups, strong circular motion around the creator, subjects in center 65%, generous top breathing room, bottom 15% quiet for subtitles, phone-readable silhouettes
Color palette: cobalt blue accents, sunflower yellow, tomato red, sage green, charcoal black on warm-white paper
Constraints: no text, no letters, no digits, no logos, no watermark, no gradients, no photorealism, no 3D, no interface, no extra characters; keep cards separated for animation
shots.video_prompt: Use the supplied FIRST frame as the exact start and the supplied LAST frame as the exact end. Create a 6-second vertical 9:16 tactile low-frame-rate paper stop-motion transition with a locked flat frontal camera. Preserve the creator, face, pose, scale, blue circular time anchor, warm-white paper, crayon linework, and palette exactly. 0.0–0.8s: hold the FIRST frame. 0.8–4.5s: six additional rigid blank paper cards enter one by one from the outer edges and make staggered handmade hops around the fixed creator; draw the tomato-red paths in short crayon increments behind the cards. 4.5–5.4s: the seven cards complete one restrained clockwise tightening motion while the blue circle pulses once. 5.4–6.0s: settle precisely into the LAST frame. Interpolate only the incoming cards and red paths; do not invent any change that is absent from the two supplied frames. No camera drift, pan, tilt, zoom, parallax, depth rotation, face morphing, body deformation, card fusion, readable text, letters, digits, logos, watermark, photorealism, or 3D. No audio.

shots.title: 统一收集
shots.narration: Agent 的第一步不是回答，而是把任务收进同一个入口。
shots.start_state: 人物、漏斗、机器和黄色托盘固定；多组空白任务卡悬浮在漏斗上方，人物手中仍有一张卡。
shots.end_state: 漏斗上方清空，人物双手为空；五张空白任务卡整齐叠放在黄色托盘中。

shots.title: 识别阻塞
shots.narration: 接着识别依赖、优先级，找出真正卡住进度的阻塞点。
shots.start_state: 放大镜对准最左侧任务卡，红色 X 在依赖链右侧但尚未被聚焦，黄色绕行箭头不存在。
shots.end_state: 放大镜移动并对准红色 X，黄色绕行箭头完整出现。

shots.title: 编排流程
shots.narration: 然后把混乱重排成一条可以执行、可以检查的工作流。
shots.start_state: 人物与机器固定；左侧六张任务卡仍然散乱，右侧红色 X 表示阻塞，机器只露出短黄色输出片。
shots.end_state: 左侧任务卡全部进入机器；黄色清单与三步工作流完全展开，红色 X 翻转为绿色通过标记。
shots.image_prompt: Existing completed keyframe supplied by the project. Preserve the Q-version creator, cobalt-blue assistant machine, scattered blank task cards, arrows, and sunflower-yellow checklist on warm-white crayon paper.

shots.title: 执行闭环
shots.narration: 价值不在多说一句，而在下一步真的被推进，并留下可复查的结果。
shots.start_state: 人物握住抬起的蓝色拉杆；机器只露出短黄色输出片，绿色结果托盘为空。
shots.end_state: 拉杆已触发；黄色流程带向上展开，五张勾选卡沿流程移动，其中一张进入绿色结果托盘。
